definitions.explanation: A physically attractive woman. Slightly literary or formal compared to neutral {美人|びじん}; often used in set phrases, news headlines, and entertainment-industry contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{美女|びじょ}だ。
⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美女|びじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっていた→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many beautiful women had gathered at the party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{王子|おうじ}→王子：01904_ouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{呪|のろ}い→呪い：15822_noroi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけられた{美女|びじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救|すく}う→救う：02063_sukuu⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: In old folk tales, scenes often appear in which a prince rescues a beautiful woman who has been put under a curse.

notes:
Slightly more literary and formal than ⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧. Common in titles, headlines, idioms, and fairy-tale contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{絶世|ぜっせい}→絶世：17116_zessei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美女|びじょ}: a peerless beauty
- {美女|びじょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{野獣|やじゅう}: Beauty and the Beast
- {美女|びじょ}⟦{揃|そろ}い→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: a gathering of beautiful women
- {才色兼備|さいしょくけんび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美女|びじょ}: a beauty with both talent and looks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧: beautiful woman — the most neutral, everyday term
- ⟦{美少女|びしょうじょ}→美少女：14337_bishoujo⟧: beautiful young girl — emphasizes youth
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧: handsome man — male counterpart in casual speech
